items.name: notify-envelope
items.title: Notify envelope
items.description: Pure helpers: build a roster from per-channel lists, compare lists, and build a one-message To/Cc envelope.

items.name: status-strip
items.title: Status strip
items.description: A headline number, a segmented bar and a legend for the stages of one whole, with a slot for the action that acts on it.

items.name: save-bar
items.title: Save bar
items.description: An 'Unsaved changes' bar with Discard and Save that only renders when there is something to save.

items.name: confirm-send
items.title: Confirm send
items.description: Click, confirm with the recipient count, send, then a 'Sent to N' status line. Can be blocked with a reason.

items.name: recipient-roster
items.title: Recipient roster
items.description: One list of people with a switch per channel, per-channel limits, paste-to-add and inline validation.

items.name: status-notify
items.title: Status and notify
items.description: A status headline, a confirm-then-send action, and one recipient roster with save/discard, wired together.
